kazakhstan-2004.notes: None of the six Eolymp pages names the contest or a letter; the match rests on the titles agreeing with the catalogue's A-K list (Eolymp spells F as 'Fool`s Day'). The example data on every page is fetched by script from eolympusercontent.com and was not captured; a capture that saves those files would complete the examples.

kazakhstan-2026.notes: The Kazakhstan page gives two 'Contest Dates' rows, 14 Nov, 26 and 18 Oct, 26, without saying which is the qualification; contest_date left null although 14 Nov matches the catalogue. The 2026 standings page (archive/2026/kazakhstan/standings.html) is in the crawl and could be its own scoreboard source. Team rows include member names.

sources.evidence: The NERC page 'Kazakhstan Regional Contest' lists 2026 in its archive and our copy holds the linked standings headed 'ICPC 2026–2027 Kazakhstan Regional Contest'.
